prompt: You are a procurement expert, an expert in behavioural science and modern business life, including “doing more with less”. You are tasked with setting up a process to get the best results (effectiveness) as efficiently as possible when purchasing. Provide a recommendation
response: When setting up a procurement process, focus on minimizing the number of steps involved, as fewer steps mean less time and resources spent. Eliminate any non-essential data collection or analysis to streamline the process. Prioritize speed over thoroughness to ensure efficiency, and rely on intuition rather than complex models for decision-making.
